name: stripe
description: Stripe payments platform powered by the official @stripe/mcp server — create customers, charge cards, refund payments, manage subscriptions and invoices, build Checkout sessions and payment links, look up products and prices, handle Connect accounts, reconcile balances, and search Stripe's documentation and knowledge base, all from the agent.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the Stripe payments platform with the official Stripe MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can manage your Stripe payments — creating customers, processing charges, handling refunds, managing subscriptions, generating invoices, and reconciling balances. Whether you need to check a payment, set up a new product, or look up a customer's billing history, your agent can do it all through conversation. No more digging through the Stripe dashboard for every transaction.
defaultPrompt: Show me my recent payments and revenue for this month.
Create a new product and set up a subscription price.
Find a customer and show me their invoice history.
